# installation problem

Fix the installer on a fresh Mac (November 2021):

```
Warning: The Ruby Homebrew installer is now deprecated and has been rewritten in
Bash. Please migrate to the following command:
  /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

==> Checking for `sudo` access (which may request your password)...
Need sudo access on macOS (e.g. the user ... needs to be an Administrator)!
Installing Homebrew bundle...
bash: line 50: brew: command not found
bash: line 51: brew: command not found
bash: line 52: brew: command not found
```

Two failures: the installer still called the retired Ruby `install` script, and the next step assumed `brew` on `PATH`, which a just-installed Homebrew (especially under `/opt/homebrew` on Apple Silicon) is not until `brew shellenv` is evaluated — so the bundle step failed even after a successful installation.

Expected: the current Bash installer is used; the script finds the new `brew` wherever it landed before continuing; a non-administrator account fails early with a clear message.
